title: Add three-way customer evidence reconciliation view for orders, shipments and invoices
description: Add a bounded read-only three-way reconciliation view exposing ERP-055 invoice-to-order allocations, ERP-076 invoice-to-shipment links and ERP-073 receipt allocations for a Customer, keeping each evidence class separately labeled. Do not create a general ledger, assert revenue recognition, contact customers, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: The view lists recorded customer sales-invoice evidence, linked Sales Orders, linked shipments and active receipt allocations without copying source rows or creating another master.
Users can apply bounded or paged filters for Customer, invoice identity, order number, shipment identity, invoice-date range, currency and allocation state using persisted fields only.
Ordered, shipped, invoiced and explicitly receipted evidence remain in separate labeled columns; the view never subtracts one class from another or asserts a settled, recognized or audited balance.
Amounts are grouped by currency and different currencies are never combined, converted or reassigned without an authoritative persisted conversion already belonging to the source evidence.
Draft, voided or cancelled source evidence is separately labeled and excluded from active reconciliation totals; missing or invalid links remain visible as unknown and are not repaired or reassigned.
The view states that it is operational evidence reconciliation, not a general ledger, audited Customer statement, revenue recognition, tax filing, payment demand or settlement confirmation.

Opening order, shipment, invoice or allocation detail revalidates authentication and module authorization and fails closed when an authoritative source is deleted, unavailable or no longer authorized.
List and aggregate queries are bounded, avoid per-row database access, do not call external services and keep legacy Customers readable without request-time or production backfill.
The view is read-only and does not change Customers, Sales Orders, shipments, containers, invoices, allocations, receipts, inventory, tax, finance or settlement records.
Any export uses the same filtered, currency-separated and evidence-class-separated semantics as the screen and contains no hidden cross-currency total or inferred legal assertion.

Unit and integration tests cover no evidence, partial evidence across the three classes, void and cancelled history, multiple Customers and currencies, bounded queries, authorization failure and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Open the three-way reconciliation view for a Customer with order, shipment, invoice and receipt evidence and verify each evidence class is separately labeled in one currency without a settled or recognized assertion.
Inspect partially linked, draft, voided, cancelled and missing evidence and verify unknown values remain separate, no cross-class subtraction is shown and no source record is changed.

human_gate.reason: Read-only evidence reconciliation over repository records and non-production validation only. Customer contact, real collection, shipment execution, customs submission, accounting or tax action, production database mutation, deployment and release remain behind mandatory human gates.
